theater: 卡迭石與奧龍特斯河上游

battle.name: 拉美西斯二世的戰爭
battle.theater: 卡迭石與奧龍特斯河上游
battle.brief: 公元前1274年5月，拉美西斯二世率埃及大軍北上，在卡迭石城下與赫梯王穆瓦塔里二世接戰。赫梯戰車迂迴包抄，拉美西斯二世親率近衛反衝脫圍，兩軍在河畔拉成僵持。這是有詳細陣形記載的最早會戰，也是史上戰車最多的一役。卡面長矛在步兵縱隊後列待命，刺馬腿、斷韁繩。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 拉美西斯二世的戰爭，主體是埃及新王國第十九王朝對上赫梯帝國，但真正上陣的是混合了屬國、雇兵與俘虜的聯軍。埃及軍由法老本人任最高統帥，帳下設四個步兵師：阿蒙師、拉師、普塔師、塞特師，另配獨立的弓箭手大隊與戰車部隊，禁衛隊則緊貼法老本人。每一師由王子或高級軍官分領，元帥總理帕赫西居中調度，兒子們各掌一翼。赫梯方面由國王穆瓦塔里二世直接指揮，麾下除本國步兵與數千輛戰車外，還有北方盟友與附庸國派來的援軍，兵力分列卡迭石城北、奧龍特斯河東岸樹林之後與縱隊尾方。埃及在黎凡特的屬國迦南、腓尼基與阿穆魯夾在兩強之間，阿穆魯更一度倒向赫梯，成為拉美西斯北伐的直接導火線。戰爭另有一條南方戰線：前三年拉美西斯在尼羅河三角洲西部擊退利比亞人，前後三次遠征努比亞，把疆界重新推回第三瀑布一帶。
countriesEn: The wars of Ramesses II pitted the New Kingdom of Egypt, nineteenth dynasty, against the Hittite empire, though the armies that actually fought were mixed coalitions of vassal states, mercenaries and prisoners of war. On the Egyptian side the pharaoh himself was supreme commander, and the host was divided into four infantry divisions — the Amun, Ra, Ptah and Seth — backed by a separate body of archers and by the chariot corps, with the royal guard in attendance on the king himself. Each division was commanded by a prince or a senior officer, while the vizier Panhesy coordinated the whole and put his own sons in charge of the wings. The Hittite force was led directly by the king Muwatalli II; besides his own infantry and several thousand chariots he brought contingents from northern allies and client states, deployed behind the walls of Kadesh, in the woods east of the Orontes, and in the rear of his marching column. Egypt's Levantine dependencies — Canaan, Phoenicia and Amurru — were caught between the two powers, and Amurru swung over to the Hittites, becoming the direct trigger for Ramesses' northern offensive. A southern front ran in parallel: in his third year Ramesses beat back the Libu in the western Delta, and he made three expeditions into Nubia that pushed the frontier back towards the Third Cataract.
people: 拉美西斯二世（公元前1279至前1213年在位）是這場衝突的絕對中心。他二十五歲即位，在位約六十六年，前後發動過十五次以上的遠征，本卡所指的一連串戰爭正是他統治前半段的西北戰線。隔著奧龍特斯河與他對峙的是赫梯王穆瓦塔里二世，兄弟數人隨軍出征：一位王弟戰死在卡迭石，另一位赫梯王子被俘，後來在城下列陣時獲釋。埃及一方的實際操盤者是元帥總理帕赫西，他的四個兒子分掌要職，荷利與阿蒙威亞領兵前進，奈布美爾特守後營，門圖赫克佩舍夫指揮弓箭手，弓箭手在戰役中上前拉開陣地，接住了被衝散的拉師殘兵。戰後由書吏潘陶爾撰寫《卡迭石之戰詩篇》，梅內普塔下令將其刻於卡爾納克。拉美西斯二世本人最關鍵的一個決定，是在被包圍時放棄潰退、帶近衛反衝敵陣，戰後又以公報形式把這一幕寫成自己的功績。
peopleEn: Ramesses II (on the throne from 1279 to 1213 BC) is the absolute centre of this conflict. He acceded at twenty-five, reigned for roughly sixty-six years and fought more than fifteen campaigns; the series of wars represented by this card is the north-western front of the first half of his reign. Facing him across the Orontes was the Hittite king Muwatalli II, who campaigned with several of his brothers: one royal brother was killed at Kadesh and another Hittite prince was captured, only to be released later when the captives were paraded before the town. The real operator of the Egyptian host was the vizier Panhesy, whose four sons held key commands — Hori and Amenemwia led the advance, Nebmert held the rear, and Mentuherkhepeshef commanded the archers, who moved forward to plug the gap left by the scattered Ra division. After the battle the scribe Pentaur composed the Poem of Pentaur, and Merneptah ordered it carved at Karnak. The single most consequential decision was Ramesses' own: refusing to break away when encircled, he counter-charged with his guard, and afterwards wrote the whole episode up as his personal triumph in the form of a bulletin.
kits: 卡面這支埃及長矛，是早王朝以來銅或青銅矛頭裝在木杆上的形制；到新王國已改為套筒式青銅矛頭配白木長杆，但仍是埃及步兵最普遍、最廉價的刺擊兵器。主力步兵線上配長矛，用來結陣與反衝；弓箭手身旁的矛手負責護住射界；努比亞與邁杰的輕裝射手另備短標槍投擲。拉美西斯二世隊伍中，長矛最常見的實戰任務不是正面刺殺，而是對付戰車：矛尖插入車輪之間、刺穿馬腿、割斷韁繩，把高速衝來的雙馬戰車釘在原地。卡爾納克與阿布辛貝壁畫裡的埃及步兵，多是左手持盾、右手挺矛，矛尖斜指前方。除長矛外，埃及軍還配備直刃短劍（早於此已取代月牙劍成為主力）、複合弓與箭、斧頭與投石索、輕型雙馬戰車（兩人：一駕一射），以及圍城用的撞錘、繩梯與在達普爾城牆下掘進的地道。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card is the type with a copper or bronze head fixed to a wooden shaft, going back to the early dynastic period; by the New Kingdom the head had become a socketed bronze blade on a white-wood shaft, but the spear remained the commonest and cheapest thrusting weapon of the Egyptian infantry. The main battle line was armed with it, to form up and to counter-charge; spearmen stood beside the archers to shield the shooting lanes; Nubian and Medjay light infantry carried short javelins for throwing. In Ramesses' host the spear's commonest battlefield task was not frontal killing but the fight against chariots: the point was driven between the wheels, into the legs of the horses or at the reins, pinning a fast-moving two-horse chariot to the spot. The Egyptian infantry shown in the Karnak and Abu Simbel reliefs are mostly portrayed with a shield in the left hand and a spear in the right, its point angled forward. Besides the spear, the Egyptian army carried straight-edged short swords (the khopesh had already been superseded as the main blade), composite bows and arrows, axes and slings, light two-horse chariots with a driver and an archer, and for siege work battering rams, rope ladders, and the tunnel driven beneath the walls of Dapur.
tactics: 埃及軍自三角洲新都皮拉美西斯出發，排成狹長縱隊北進：拉師行在最前，阿蒙師緊隨法老，普塔師與塞特師作預備隊殿後，直線北進數日後抵達奧龍特斯河。渡河時隊形拉長，縱隊首部已過北岸而尾部仍在南岸，縱深反而成了弱點。赫梯軍隱蔽在卡迭石城北與河東岸的樹林裡，等埃及先頭部隊過河才突然襲擊。拉師在野外展開陣線時被赫梯戰車從側翼撞散，潰兵北奔至阿蒙營，拉美西斯二世本人被近衛護著陷入包圍。他拒絕南撤，下令阿蒙師就地結陣，並親自駕車連同近衛與拉師殘部反衝，直插赫梯縱隊中部；赫梯人見埃及營帳空虛，捨下追擊轉而劫掠行李，隊形因此散開，埃及的追擊隨即把殘餘戰車壓回奧龍特斯河，殘兵泅水而渡。攻城方面，達普爾是靠圍城與挖穿牆基的地道取下來的，而非正面強攻。
tacticsEn: The Egyptian army marched north from Pi-Ramesses, the new capital in the Delta, drawn out in a long column: the Ra division led, the Amun division marched close behind the king, and the Ptah and Seth divisions formed the rearguard as a reserve, reaching the Orontes after several days of straight marching. The crossing stretched the formation out, the head of the column already on the northern bank while the tail was still on the southern one, and that lack of depth became the weakness. The Hittites lay hidden behind Kadesh to the north and in the woods east of the river, and struck only once the Egyptian leading troops had crossed. The Ra division was caught in the open as it deployed and was scattered by Hittite chariots coming in from the flank; the fugitives ran north towards the Amun camp, and Ramesses II himself, guarded by his personal guard, was surrounded. He refused to withdraw south, ordered the Amun division to form where it stood, and personally charged with his guard and the survivors of the Ra division straight into the middle of the Hittite column. Believing the Egyptian camp empty, the Hittites gave up the pursuit to plunder the tents and baggage, which broke up their order; the Egyptian counter-attack then drove the remaining chariots back to the Orontes, and the survivors swam for it. In the siege operations Dapur was taken by blockade and by a tunnel driven under the foundations of the wall, not by frontal assault.
data: 拉美西斯二世的公報與詩篇留下的數字需要分層看。埃及出動兵力一般估在二萬人上下，戰車約二千輛；其中拉師報一萬人、二千匹馬，阿蒙師報五千人、一千匹馬，兩師相加已近全軍之數。赫梯方面，拉美西斯在公報中宣稱穆瓦塔里率難以計數的盟國而來，戰車多達五千輛、馬匹八千，學界據此把全役戰車總數推估為五千至六千輛，普遍認為這是史上規模最大的戰車之戰。埃及方面的傷亡估計落差極大，從二千到一萬不等；赫梯沒有可靠數字，但可確定穆瓦塔里的一位王弟陣亡、大批戰車在追擊中被毀或溺斃於河中。距離與時間：法老在卡迭石以南約十一公里的沙布圖納附近遇上赫梯派來的假偵探，對方謊稱國王遠在北面約兩百公里的阿勒頗一帶。日期定於王位第五年第三個月第九日，通常換算為公元前1274年5月（低年代學說；高年代學說早約二十年）。和約則在王位第二十一年、公元前1258年簽訂，比會戰晚約十五年。
dataEn: The figures that survive from Ramesses' bulletins and poems have to be read in layers. Egyptian strength is generally put at something like twenty thousand men with about two thousand chariots; the Ra division is credited with ten thousand men and two thousand horses and the Amun division with five thousand men and a thousand horses, so those two divisions alone come close to the whole host. On the Hittite side Ramesses' bulletin claims that Muwatalli came with a host of allies beyond counting, five thousand chariots and eight thousand horses; on that basis scholars put the total number of chariots engaged at five to six thousand, and it is generally accepted that this was the largest chariot engagement in history. Estimates of Egyptian losses vary enormously, from two thousand to ten thousand. No reliable figure exists for the Hittites, but it is certain that one of Muwatalli's royal brothers was killed and that a large number of chariots were destroyed in the pursuit or drowned in the river. On distance and timing: the king came upon Hittite false scouts about eleven kilometres south of Kadesh, near Shabtuna, and they claimed the king was far away, some two hundred kilometres north around Aleppo. The date is fixed to the ninth day of the third month of the fifth regnal year, normally converted to May 1274 BC on the low chronology; the high chronology is about twenty years earlier. The peace treaty was signed in the twenty-first regnal year, 1258 BC, roughly fifteen years after the battle.
cause: 導火線是赫梯在敘利亞的全面擴張。第十八王朝末到第十九王朝初，赫梯王穆瓦塔里二世趁埃及的注意力轉向南方與三角洲，趁阿穆魯與卡迭石一帶的埃及勢力退潮，扶持西頓等城邦反叛，兵鋒直抵奧龍特斯河谷，切斷埃及通往敘利亞內陸的通道。拉美西斯二世即位後先在三角洲建都皮拉美西斯、整頓軍力，前四年已數度小試：第三年打擊利比亞人，第四年取回阿舒卡倫與加薩一帶的南線，第五年北上本為收復阿穆魯、重新打通北方商路，未料赫梯主力已集結待戰，遂爆發卡迭石之戰。矛盾的底層是兩個帝國對誰管得了西頓至阿穆魯這條邊境走廊的爭奪，而兩邊在會戰中又都無法把對方從邊境趕走。
causeEn: The spark was the Hittite advance into Syria. Between the end of the eighteenth dynasty and the opening of the nineteenth, the Hittite king Muwatalli II exploited the fact that Egyptian attention had turned southward and inward, and while Egypt's position around Amurru and Kadesh had slackened he backed the revolt of towns such as Tunip, pushing his spearhead down the Orontes valley and cutting Egypt's road into the interior of Syria. Ramesses II, once on the throne, first built his new capital Pi-Ramesses in the Delta and reorganised his army, and spent his first four years in smaller actions: the Libu were struck in the third year, and in the fourth the southern line around Ashkelon and Gaza was recovered. The fifth-year campaign north was meant to retake Amurru and reopen the northern trade routes, but the main Hittite force was already assembled and waiting, and the battle of Kadesh followed. Underneath lay the question of which empire would govern the corridor from Tunip to Amurru — and after the fighting, neither could drive the other out of that borderland.
impact: 短期看，埃及在亞嫩洲的霸權第一次被正面挑戰，卻沒有崩壞：埃及仍守住從加薩到比洛克一線的南黎凡特，卻失去了北部走廊的主動權，阿穆魯改為向赫梯稱臣，北方小國在兩個帝國之間左右逢源。長期看，這場戰爭最耐用的產物是那份刻在銀板上的和約——王位第二十一年、公元前1258年，拉美西斯二世與新王哈圖西里三世簽訂，除劃界與互不侵犯外，還包括引渡逃亡者、准許雙方國民自由往來，甚至呼籲共同抵禦「海上民族」式的入侵；它被公認為現存最早的國際和平條約，之後數百年的亞述與巴比倫尼亞和約都沿用同一套格式，兩河流域出土的後世阿卡德語和約文本中同樣可以看見它的影子。宣傳上，卡迭石壁畫把一場打成僵持的會戰畫成法老大破敵軍，阿布辛貝與卡爾納克的浮雕是這場戰爭最長久的物質紀錄。後世對拉美西斯「出埃及」角色的想像，也在此後幾個世紀被梅內普塔及其子孫的紀念碑不斷放大。
impactEn: In the short term Egypt's dominance in the Levant was challenged for the first time in earnest but did not collapse: Egypt held the southern Levant from Gaza to Byblos, yet lost the initiative in the northern corridor, Amurru passed under Hittite suzerainty, and the small northern states hedged their bets between the two empires. In the long term the most durable product of the war was the peace treaty inscribed on a silver tablet — in the twenty-first regnal year, 1258 BC, Ramesses II concluded it with the new king Hattusili III, laying out a frontier, binding each side to refrain from aggression, providing for the extradition of fugitives, opening the border to the free passage of subjects of both crowns, and even appealing for joint defence against incursions of the Sea Peoples kind. It is generally recognised as the earliest surviving international peace treaty, and the treaties of Assyria and Babylonia over the following centuries follow the same pattern, with the later Akkadian treaty texts found in Mesopotamia showing the same shadow. In terms of propaganda, the reliefs of Kadesh turned a stalemate into a triumph of the pharaoh over a broken enemy, and the carvings at Abu Simbel and Karnak remain the war's most enduring physical record. The later image of Ramesses as the Pharaoh of the Exodus was likewise magnified, over the following centuries, by the monuments of Merneptah and his descendants.
result: 卡迭石之戰以僵持告終：埃及沒有攻下這座有城牆與引水渠的城市，拉美西斯二世因無法長期圍城而收兵，沿奧龍特斯河谷南下，經大馬士革返回三角洲，碑文卻記作大勝。赫梯的代價更重——一位王弟陣亡，數百輛戰車在河邊被毀或溺斃，追擊時劫掠埃及營地的舉動也讓全軍失去戰鬥節奏。戰事並未因此結束：拉美西斯在王位第八、九年再攻，拿下自圖特摩斯三世以來約一百二十年未有埃及士兵見過的達普爾與圖尼普，但這條夾在阿穆魯與卡迭石之間的狹長地帶無法防守，一年內即回到赫梯手中，王位第十年他再度出征，仍未能根除。最後的結局是一份和約：第二十一年與哈圖西里三世簽訂銀板條約，劃定以奧龍特斯河為主的勢力線，埃及在北黎凡特的主張就此收束，拉美西斯二世餘下的五十多年在阿布辛貝與卡爾納克的營造中度過，直至公元前1213年去世。
resultEn: The battle of Kadesh ended in a stalemate. Egypt did not take the city, with its walls and its water channels, and Ramesses II, unable to maintain a siege, withdrew his troops, marched down the Orontes valley, and returned to the Delta by way of Damascus, while his inscriptions recorded the affair as a great victory. The Hittites paid more: a royal brother killed, several hundred chariots destroyed at the riverbank or drowned, and the decision to plunder the Egyptian camp during the pursuit robbed their army of its battle order. The war did not end there. In his eighth and ninth regnal years Ramesses campaigned again and took Dapur and Tunip, the first Egyptian soldiers to see those towns for some hundred and twenty years since Thutmose III, but the narrow strip between Amurru and Kadesh could not be held: within a year it was back under Hittite control, and in his tenth year the king marched again without rooting the enemy out. The outcome that finally closed the matter was a treaty: in his twenty-first year he concluded the silver-tablet treaty with Hattusili III, drawing a line of influence along the Orontes, after which Egypt's claims in the northern Levant were settled. Ramesses II spent the remaining fifty-some years of his life building at Abu Simbel and Karnak, and died in 1213 BC.
